# A little about me.

::: {.about-intro}
I'm Trevor, a senior studying Cyber Science at the United States Military Academy with an interest in network operations, offensive cyber operations, and ethical hacking.
:::

I expect to graduate in June 2027.

## What I'm learning

I enjoy taking ideas beyond the classroom and putting them into practice. TryHackMe and personal projects give me opportunities to explore, experiment, and build a deeper understanding of cyber security.

I'm especially interested in the relationship between understanding how systems work and understanding how to protect them.

## Beyond the screen

Weightlifting and grappling are important parts of my life. So is my faith. They belong here alongside my academic and technical interests, because a professional introduction should still feel personal.

## Follow along

You can find my public work on [GitHub](https://github.com/t-patton93) and my learning profile on [TryHackMe](https://tryhackme.com/p/trevordpatton).
